map.assessor-27：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: assessor-27: enter the parameters online to get a result instantly, with no installation and no registration.
map.优先查看标注为低分的维度，它们是当前短板；把整改资源集中到最低分项，能在下一轮评: Look first at the dimensions flagged as low, since they are the current weaknesses; concentrating remediation on the lowest item lifts the overall score faster in the next assessment.
map.分数偏低怎么用？: How do I use a low score?
map.各维度满分多少？: What is the maximum score per dimension?
map.团队自评：按各维度逐项打分，定位知识管理的薄弱环节: Team self-assessment: score each dimension item by item to locate weak links in knowledge management
map.横向对比：多部门或多次评估，观察成熟度趋势: Side-by-side comparison: assess multiple departments or multiple times to observe the maturity trend
map.每个维度按 0–10 分自评，0 为尚未开展、10 为完全成熟；综合评分取各维度: Score each dimension 0-10, where 0 means not started and 10 fully mature; the overall score is the mean of the dimensions and maps onto five maturity levels.
map.管理改进：依据综合评分与等级，制定下一阶段提升计划: Management improvement: use the overall score and grade to formulate the next stage of improvement plan
map.：例（六个维度分别打 8、7、6、9、7、8 分）：综合评分 = (8+7+6+: : example (the six dimensions score 8, 7, 6, 9, 7 and 8): overall score = (8+7+6+9+7+8) / 6 = 7.50/10, reaching "level 4 - managed" (6.5 or above and below 8). This shows the dimensions are generally sound and a few can be pushed further to reach level 5.
